title: Does Night Cream Expire? Shelf Life, PAO and Storage
ex: Yes. Check the use-before date and the open-jar PAO symbol on your pack. How to read them, signs a cream has gone off, and how to store it in Indian weather.
rt: Does Night Cream Expire? Shelf Life & Storage | Mirc Glow
rd: Does night cream expire? How to read the use-before date and PAO symbol, signs a face cream has gone off, and how to store it in Indian heat and humidity.
quick: Yes. A sealed night cream is good until the use-before date on the pack. Once opened, follow the PAO symbol, an open jar marked 6M or 12M, and use it within those months or by the use-before date, whichever comes first. Throw it away if the smell, colour or texture changes.
facts: PAO means months a cream stays good after opening
Use whichever comes first: PAO or use-before date
Store creams cool, shaded and out of the bathroom
Changed smell, colour or texture means throw it away
